description: Reported annual financials of a Japanese listed company from its EDINET annual securities report: net sales, operating income, net income attributable to owners of the parent, total assets, net assets, with fiscal period, accounting standard (J-GAAP / IFRS / US GAAP), the filing document id, and margins. Each amount states its currency and unit and is the full-fiscal-year figure as filed; an amount whose unit cannot be established is returned unresolved, never guessed. A filer without structured data returns found:false. Requires a free EDINET Subscription-Key via _apiKey. Example: edinet_financials({ sec_code: "8035" }).

fiscal_year.description: Calendar year in which the fiscal year ends (March 2026 year end = 2026). Default: the latest filed.

name: edinet_financials
